rows.note: This is the all-purpose polite term for addressing or referring to an adult woman, especially in public or service contexts.
Use this for a female customer or an adult woman when a courteous, somewhat domestic form of address is intended.

example.english: madam, this dress looks great on you.
example.jyutping: taai3 taai2 ne1 gin6 kwan4 hou2 can3 nei5 wo3

rows.note: Use this formal title for the wife of a prominent man or when addressing a distinguished married woman.

example.english: madam, the ceremony is about to begin; please take your seat.
example.traditional: 夫人，典禮就快開始，請您入座。
example.jyutping: fu1 jan4 din2 lai5 zau6 faai3 hoi1 ci2 cing2 nei5 jap6 zo6
